item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric, reconstruct the Urdu verse from the Roman text, and check that both versions align stanza by stanza.

item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "کون ہے یہ مستور جو اب تک اصغرؑ اصغرؑ کہتی ہے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Kon hai ye mastoor jo ab tak asghar asghar kehti hai
Saaye se ghabhrati haior dhoop me baythi rehti hai

1
1.Pyas ke aalam me paani ko, dekh ke aahein bharti hai
Haath bhigo kar pani mekuch khaak pe likhti rehti hai

2
2.Dard bhari lori kehti hai, eik jaley jhooley ke paas
Khoon aaluda kurtey sephir baatein karti rehti hai

3
3.Maa ki nazro ke aaghey koi, beta baap ke hatho par
Dam na torey ay Allahye duaein maangti rehti hai

4
4.Ab tak aas hai dukhyari ko, asghar laut ke ayega
Nehr e furaat ki raaho koye pal pal takti rehti hai

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/kaun-hai-ye-mstor-jo-ab-tk-asghar-asghar-kehti-hai.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(lines):
    return [block.splitlines() for block in '\\n'.join(line.strip() for line in lines.splitlines()).strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r, u = blocks(roman), blocks(body)
assert list(map(len,r)) == list(map(len,u)) == [2,3,3,3,3]
assert [b[0] for b in r[1:]] == list('1234')
assert [b[0] for b in u[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴')
print('Verified two opening verses and four matched two-verse stanzas.')
PY"
